title: Guard
subtitle: Behaviour control on every model call: routes simple turns to the small model, blocks actions that break the playbook and validates answers. Everything shows up in the trace.

toggle.label: Guard enabled
toggle.needsPlaybook: Generate or write the playbook to enable Guard.
toggle.unsaved: Save the playbook changes before enabling it.
toggle.hasErrors: Fix the playbook errors before enabling it.
toggle.disableDescription: Calls from {member} will no longer go through the playbook: no model routing, no blocked actions and no answer validation.
toggle.viewer: Read only: you need the builder role to change Guard.
toggle.planTitle: Guard is not included in your plan
toggle.planDescription: You can prepare the playbook now and enable it once you upgrade.

generate.confirmDescription: The current policies will be replaced by a new proposal based on the agent's code, configuration and tools. Guard stays enabled or disabled as it is.
generate.byRules: Proposed by rules from the configuration

empty.title: This agent has no playbook yet
empty.description: Generate a proposal from the agent and adjust it, or start from an empty playbook.
empty.viewerDescription: A project builder can generate the playbook.

editor.invalid: The playbook has errors: check the highlighted fields.

models.title: Models
models.smallHint: Simple turns and the votes of semantic policies.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Turn policies are evaluated in order and the first match decides the model or the answer. Tool policies apply to every call and any block wins.
policies.empty: No policies: every call uses the agent's model and no action is blocked.
policies.removeDescription: It is removed from the draft. Nothing changes until you save the playbook.

policy.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores.
policy.conditionHint: Optional. When set, the small model votes three times. Without a condition the policy is resolved without any model.
policy.matchHint: Every check you fill in must hold.
policy.patternsHint: One regular expression per line, case-insensitive.
policy.factsHint: Comma-separated. Built-in: tool:<tool> (it already returned a result) and approval:<tool> (a human approved it).
policy.responseHint: Optional. Answers without calling any model.
policy.constraintsAlways: No conditions: applies to every call of the tool.
policy.messageHint: Optional. Replaces the blocked call in the agent's answer.
policy.ungated: “{tool}” has no approval gate in the agent: Guard will block these calls unless a human already approved them in the conversation.
policy.gated: “{tool}” requires approval in the agent: the run pauses so a human can decide.

schema.title: Output schema
schema.description: JSON Schema the agent's final answers must follow. When an answer does not, Guard asks the model to fix it once.
schema.label: JSON Schema

codes.unknown_model: {model} is not in the model catalog.
codes.fact_never_provided: No policy provides “{fact}”: the requirement can never hold.
codes.noop_policy: The policy neither routes, answers nor provides facts.
codes.matches_every_turn: No match and no condition: it applies to every turn and hides the policies below.
codes.approval_not_gated: “{tool}” does not require approval in the agent: Guard will block these calls unless already approved. Mark the tool as “requires approval”.

client.invalid_id: Invalid id: use lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores, starting with a letter.
client.response_with_tool: A policy with a fixed answer cannot act on tools.
